title: Region: the Fields of Asphodel
prompt: An isometric bird's-eye view, like a big open level of Minecraft Dungeons seen from the game's high three-quarter camera, every part built from chunky blocks with hand-painted pixel textures, a few small blocky heroes (Percy in his orange camp shirt, Annabeth, Grover) for scale, monsters about, a glowing marble-and-gold waystone pillar somewhere on a path. The Fields of Asphodel where the Underworld breaks through, eternal grey twilight, monster level 9 to 12: grey ash plains carpeted with pale asphodel flowers, black poplar trees, wandering ghostly shades, the River Styx with a ferry landing and Charon's boat, braziers of green fire, a steep hill with a boulder being pushed up it, the great black gates of Erebus with a huge empty dog collar beside them, a stone shrine to Hades with a dark helm, and a pale armoured skeleton king with a crown and a black sword (the region's champion). Eerie but not gory. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
generation_prompt:
